# Sahara Vacation

> Luxury desert tours and camel treks in the Moroccan Sahara. Private Berber camps, stargazing nights, 4x4 routes and multi-day trekking adventures departing from Merzouga, Zagora, M'Hamid, Marrakech, Ouarzazate and Agadir.

## About

Sahara Vacation is a boutique Moroccan desert tour operator based in Merzouga. We organize private and small-group experiences across Erg Chebbi and Erg Chigaga: full-moon camel treks, luxury mobile camps, nomad and Berber immersion programs, Atlas-to-Sahara road journeys and bespoke private departures. The website is available in French (default), Spanish, German, Italian and English.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.saharavacation.com/): French default homepage.
- [Tours](https://www.saharavacation.com/tours): all desert tour itineraries.
- [Experiences](https://www.saharavacation.com/experiences): stargazing nights, nomad immersion and other experiences.
- [Custom Journey](https://www.saharavacation.com/custom-journey): design a private bespoke trip.
- [About](https://www.saharavacation.com/about): who we are and our story.
- [Contact](https://www.saharavacation.com/contact): phone, email and booking.
- [Blog](https://www.saharavacation.com/blog): Sahara travel guides and planning advice.

## Tours

- [Morocco Sahara Grand Tour - Atlas and Dunes](https://www.saharavacation.com/tours/morocco-sahara-grand-tour-dunes-atlas): 8-day journey from Marrakech across the Atlas mountains to Erg Chebbi.
- [Stargazing Night Camp](https://www.saharavacation.com/tours/stargazing-night-camp): 2 days, 1 night of astronomy and desert camping near Zagora.
- [Nomad Berber Immersion](https://www.saharavacation.com/tours/nomad-berber-immersion): live with a Berber family and experience nomadic traditions.
- [Private Bespoke Desert](https://www.saharavacation.com/tours/private-bespoke-desert): fully custom private desert itinerary.
- [Sahara Vibe trekking tours](https://www.saharavacation.com/tours): 2 to 8-day camel and 4x4 trekking routes across Erg Chigaga and Erg Chebbi.
